title: Sternicza 11 → Gulf of Gdańsk
seaLevelNote: Assumed 0 m in PL-EVRF2007-NH; no tide, waves or storm surge forecast.

model.aggregation: Maximum of every native 0.5 m DSM cell touching the EN bounding rectangle of each 1 m long × 1 m wide ray bin; missing touched cells remain missing.
model.foliage: Recorded October 2024 surface; opaque canopy, no assumed winter transparency.
model.designChanges: Existing recorded landscape only; proposed trees and building edits are not in this historical DSM.

sources.label: GUGiK PRG maritime shoreline · legal boundary

limitations: Historical acquisition, not a present-day survey.
A discrete 2° bearing search is not a proof of the global minimum height.
Narrow sampled corridors and opaque tops do not resolve gaps through foliage or windows.
Atmospheric visibility, refraction, wave height and post-acquisition changes are not modeled.
PRG is the legal maritime boundary, not a real-time waterline.
